package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for http_server_without_timeouts: Explicit http.Server{} values that omit common timeout fields.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func NewServer() *http.Server {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		w.Write([]byte("hello"))
	})
	return &http.Server{
		Addr:    ":8080",
		Handler: mux,
	}
}
